propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Exaudi, quaesumus, Domine, preces nostras, quas in beati N. Confessoris tui
atque Pontificis solemnitate deferimus: et, qui tibi digne meruit famulari,
ejus intercedentibus meritis, ab omnibus nos absolve peccatis. Per Dominum
nostrum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

translations.text: Give ear, we beseech Thee, O Lord, unto our prayers, which we offer on the solemnity of blessed N., Thy confessor and bishop, and by the interceding merits of him who had the grace to serve Thee worthily, free us from all our sins. Through our Lord.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Sancti N. Confessoris tui atque Pontificis, quaesumus, Domine, annua
solemnitas pietati tuas nos reddat acceptos: ut, per haec piae placationis
officia, et illum beata retributio comitetur, et nobis gratiae tuae dona
conciliet. Per Dominum nostrum.

indulgentiam consequamur. Per Dominum nostrum.
